title: Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2026 — Institutional Internal Hackathon
organizer: Ministry of Education & Apex Innovation Council
description: The premier nationwide initiative to provide students a platform to solve some of the pressing problems faced in daily lives, and inculcate a culture of product innovation and problem-solving mindset.
problemStatements: AI-Powered Smart Traffic Management using Existing CCTV Infrastructure
Blockchain-Enabled Automated Degree & Certificate Verification Portal
Decentralized Cold Chain Logistics Tracker for Agricultural Fresh Produce
Early Detection of Plant Diseases using Edge Computer Vision on Smartphones
rules: Each team must consist of strictly 6 members.
At least one female member is mandatory per team.
All team members must be enrolled undergraduate students.
eligibility: B.Tech students from all years and branches with zero disciplinary records.

title: Apex CodeStorm 2026: 36-Hour National Collegiate Hackathon
organizer: T&P Cell in Collaboration with AWS & Google Cloud
description: 36 hours of non-stop hacking, mentoring from Silicon Valley engineers, free food, swag packs, and direct fast-track interview opportunities for winning teams.
problemStatements: Autonomous Agentic Workflows for Local SME Invoicing & Compliance
Accessible Audio-Visual Education Tool for Neurodiverse Learners
Carbon Footprint Real-Time Verification using Satellite Imagery and ML
rules: Code must be written during the hackathon hours.
Open source libraries and APIs are permitted.
Mentors will evaluate commits on GitHub repositories.
eligibility: Open to all engineering and technology institutions across India.

title: TCS CodeVita Season 14 — Campus Selection Round
prizePool: $ 20,000 Global Purse + Direct TCS Digital & Prime Job Offers
description: The world's largest competitive coding contest certified by Guinness World Records. Solvers of 2+ questions qualify directly for TCS Prime (9 LPA) and Digital (7 LPA) interviews.
problemStatements: Graph Traversal & Minimum Spanning Tree with Dynamic Weights
rules: Strict zero-tolerance policy on plagiarism and shared code.
